import numpy as np

def example():
    frame = np.zeros((120, 160, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
    height, width = frame.shape[:2]
    box_size = 200
    x1, y1 = (width - box_size) // 2, (height - box_size) // 2

    roi = frame[y1:y2, x1:x2]
    assert roi.shape == (40, 20, 3)
    return roi
